propositions: Cloud's AcliClient.update_issue silently routes empty assignee strings and None to unassign_issue instead of passing to ACLI, but has no positive test coverage for this behavior
A regression that forwards --assignee "" or --assignee None directly to ACLI would pass all existing Cloud tests because the only test is negative
New test file test_cloud_unassign_6a74.py asserts that update_issue(key, assignee="") and update_issue(key, assignee=None) both call unassign_issue exactly once and spawn no subprocess
The co-submit case update_issue(key, assignee="", summary="new summary") calls unassign_issue once AND emits a workitem edit argv with --summary but no --assignee flag
Non-empty assignees bypass unassign_issue and take the validate-then-edit path with --assignee present in argv
